response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep systems knowledge, and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks clear evidence of staff-level technical strategy in AI-native environments, operational ownership of high-throughput distributed systems, or proven experience with Python as a primary language — all critical for this role.
strengths: Proven experience contributing to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq.
Extensive background in distributed, high-throughput systems (e.g., DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec).
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership via GISCollective and workshops.
concerns: No clear demonstration of Python mastery — required must-have skill.
Lacks explicit evidence of owning on-call rotations or incident response in production systems.
AI/ML exposure is mentioned but not deeply rooted in agentic code production environments as baseline.
